reviewed_behavior: The worker authenticates selected assets and complete current history before opening its own original backup, reconciles accepted state, and completes owner-local note recognition.
Only the absence of every unspent owned claim yields kpx8-owner-no-unspent-claim/v1. Unavailable requested note kinds while other claims exist still fail normally.
The empty result has exactly schema/participant_id_hex32/history_sha256/empty. It exposes no NF, CM, position, amount or payout script.
The launcher accepts the empty schema only for exit-ready, checks exact fields, requires literal empty=True and the externally selected history hash, and validates participant ID encoding.
No broad exception becomes empty. Missing/pruned/conflicting history or malformed own delivery still propagates failure through unchanged history validation.
scope: Source-only narrow delta after root-authorized idle boundary; previous genuine round evidence keeps its prior source identity. Financial relations, proof statements and public funding rules are unchanged.
